sources: https://secure.webreserv.com/services/bookingcalendar.do?businessid=dinnerislandranchfl (FWC's online reservation system for the WMA's camps, linked from the camping page), read 2026-10-21

fees.source: https://myfwc.com/recreation/lead/dinner-island/camping/ ('All campers must obtain a free permit/site reservation'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Hammock Camp: 17 primitive sites, 7 tent-only and 10 for tents, campers or small RVs (one an ADA RV site). One RV and one tent per RV site, two vehicles per site; no generators at sites 1-6. FWC gives no length limit.

sites.source: https://myfwc.com/recreation/lead/dinner-island/camping/ ('Hammock Camp - 17 campsites, including 1 ADA RV site and a vault toilet; 7 of those sites allow for tent camping only and 10 sites allow for tents and/or campers or small RVs'; 'RV sites are limited to one RV and one tent'; 'No generators may be operated in camp sites 1-6') + WebReserv site type description, read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://myfwc.com/recreation/lead/dinner-island/camping/ ('Hammock Camp - 17 campsites, including 1 ADA RV site and a vault toilet') + https://myfwc.com/media/1523/hammockcampground.pdf (map legend 'Vault Toilet'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every camper needs a free FWC permit/site reservation, made online (WebReserv) or by calling the South Regional Office at 561-625-5122 (Mon-Fri 8-5), up to 14 days ahead; no camping outside the designated camps. 14 consecutive days in a month, then 14 days must pass; a site left empty 48 hours may be cancelled.

booking.source: https://myfwc.com/recreation/lead/dinner-island/camping/ ('Camping within designated campgrounds is allowed by permit only'; 'Permits may be obtained up to 14 days in advance. Individuals may apply for a maximum of 14 consecutive days within a given month'; 'All campers must obtain a free permit/site reservation using the online reservation system or by calling the South Regional Office at (561) 625-5122'), read 2026-10-21

note: FWC Wildlife Management Area. Hammock Camp: primitive sites under an oak hammock, 10 for tents/campers/small RVs (1 ADA) and 7 tent-only; no amenities beyond a vault toilet. Gravel access road off CR 833 (short, washboardy, can get muddy after heavy rain). Best dry season Nov-Apr.
summary: Confirmed on FWC's camping page and its WebReserv booking page: camping still allowed, year-round, by free permit/reservation (online or by phone) up to 14 days ahead, 14-night limit; Hammock Camp has 17 sites (10 for tents/campers/small RVs, 1 ADA RV site) and a vault toilet. Not tent-only and not hunt-season-only. policy_ref is 'none' as expected. Note: count/permit/booking text dropped as structured.
flags: Size check: FWC says the 10 RV-capable Hammock Camp sites take 'campers or small RVs' and gives no length; whether a 23-ft motorhome counts as small is not stated (the map shows modest pads under oaks).
